questions.question: Which physiological variables are particularly maintained by aldosterone?

content.text: Which physiological variables are particularly maintained by aldosterone?

options.label: A
options.text: Electrolyte balance, body fluid volume, osmotic pressure and blood pressure

options.label: B
options.text: 24-hour diurnal rhythm and body temperature only

options.label: C
options.text: Cell-mediated immunity and antibody production

options.label: D
options.text: Blood calcium levels and bone remodeling

questions.explanation: Aldosterone helps in the maintenance of electrolytes, body fluid volume, osmotic pressure, and blood pressure by regulating sodium and water reabsorption in the renal tubules.

questions.question: Small amounts of androgenic steroids secreted by the adrenal cortex play a role in:

content.text: Small amounts of androgenic steroids secreted by the adrenal cortex play a role in:

options.label: A
options.text: Growth of axial hair, pubic hair and facial hair during puberty

options.label: B
options.text: Regulation of 24-hour diurnal rhythm

options.label: C
options.text: Milk ejection during lactation

options.label: D
options.text: Inhibition of erythropoiesis

questions.explanation: Small amounts of androgenic steroids are secreted by the adrenal cortex which play a role in the growth of axial hair, pubic hair and facial hair during puberty.

questions.question: The pancreas is classified as a composite gland because:

content.text: The pancreas is classified as a composite gland because:

options.label: A
options.text: It acts as both an exocrine and an endocrine gland

options.label: B
options.text: It secretes only steroid hormones

options.label: C
options.text: It is composed entirely of neural tissue

options.label: D
options.text: It is located inside the brain diencephalon

questions.explanation: Pancreas is a composite gland which acts as both exocrine and endocrine gland.

questions.question: Which cell type in the Islets of Langerhans secretes glucagon?

content.text: Which cell type in the Islets of Langerhans secretes glucagon?

options.label: A
options.text: Alpha cells

options.label: B
options.text: Beta cells

options.label: C
options.text: Acinar cells

options.label: D
options.text: Follicular cells

questions.explanation: The two main types of cells in the Islet of Langerhans are alpha-cells (which secrete glucagon) and beta-cells (which secrete insulin).

questions.question: Which combination correctly describes the primary action of glucagon on blood glucose?

content.text: Which combination correctly describes the primary action of glucagon on blood glucose?

options.label: A
options.text: Hyperglycemic hormone that stimulates glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis

options.label: B
options.text: Hypoglycemic hormone that enhances cellular glucose uptake

options.label: C
options.text: Hormone that reduces blood calcium by inhibiting osteoclasts

options.label: D
options.text: Hormone that stimulates glycogenesis in hepatocytes

questions.explanation: Glucagon is a hyperglycemic hormone; it acts on hepatocytes, stimulating glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis to increase blood sugar levels.
